disclaimer: Capability ratings are Nalkudil Studio's independent directional assessment based on public product documentation and market positioning, not vendor-verified or analyst-sourced. TCO figures are directional/qualitative tier-based sizing, not exact list prices — verify against an RFP before purchase.

platforms.name: ServiceNow
strengths: Category-leading breadth across every ITSM discipline
gaps: Highest cost tier in the set
Implementation/configuration complexity is real — longest time-to-value

platforms.name: BMC Helix ITSM
strengths: Strong enterprise incumbent with mature CMDB/asset discipline
Solid change management for regulated/ITIL-heavy shops

platforms.name: Jira Service Management
strengths: Best-in-class integration ecosystem via Atlassian Marketplace
Natural fit if engineering already lives in Jira/Confluence
gaps: CMDB/asset management is the weakest in this set
Change management lighter than ITIL-native incumbents

platforms.name: TopDesk
strengths: Clean, fast-to-adopt UI — low training overhead
Strong self-service portal out of the box
Good mid-market value for ITIL-aligned shops
gaps: Smaller integration marketplace than the majors

platforms.name: ServiceDesk Plus (ManageEngine)
strengths: Lowest cost tier in this set by a wide margin
Both cloud and on-prem editions — flexible for budget-constrained/regulated buyers
Reasonable breadth for the price point
gaps: AI/Copilot and automation depth trail every other vendor here
Less analyst/enterprise mindshare than the majors
